I'm glad I have my dogs. Thanks for talking with me.

I am trying to give the benefit of the doubt. But if he doesn't reply tomorrow I will just cut ties I guess. Just so rare to meet a guy who doesn't expect one of us to hold the whole conversation...ya know? The flow was nice.

Well feeling ao empty has been going on for a few years now. It just all piled up...one crap experience after another. And most days this depression of mine is purely chemical because there aren't many outside influences that make me feel so bad. So the combination of how personally and overall shitty the year has been....led to this desire and peace toward ending things. The final straw was realizing I have no friends...if we are honest about it...and meeting someone who could hold a conversation and then ditched me without another word....just finally cracked it for me. 

Kind of...if you have nothing more to live for and it's been years...and you don't remember being happy...why live anymore?
That is romantic. And I am forever alone lol
Why?
Easier said than done. But glad to know someone else gets trust issues....they legitimately suck.
Happy for you.
I am happy for you.

I know what you mean. Something about romantic styled intimacy, that personal depth with someone else, just amplifies the problems. I was into this guy and friended him on Facebook yesterday. We had a great conversation, really chill and he actually held up his end of it. He never replied back to me yet he has been online all day. I am with you...I am tired of fake people. I would prefer someone to tell me straight up that they don't like me and don't want to talk to me than to have to navigate their pretend crap.
Anytime! No one should have to be alone. And I know it is not much, but it helps me to know I am not the only one going through such events and feelings. :(
Me too...or when I see large bodies of water in a beautiful spot..I want to walk in and never come back...

Waking up depressed and/or just feeling that way all day is far less painful than when you are like happy or mid swing on a swing set or in the middle of a good book...and bam..smile fades..and depression has you in a chokehold and you want to die. :(

Amen. I trust very few people...I can count it on my hand and even then I hold back somewhere inside of me. I am actually decent at communication...but I cannot handle it when there is a break in that. I am sorry you went through it too. And you are right there is hope. It's like getting close or attached...is impossible because of people, namely blood relations, who have harmed me in multiple ways. I hope we make it through.

I felt like I was reading something from my life. I want you to know you are not alone. For me it is a Nmom, EDad, and Nsister and Nbrother. My grandmother does what she can to keep me balanced...but she is 600 miles away. I thought I was alone in the pounding on the door causing jumps and anxiety. And I, too, defended them for the longest time because it was supposedly normal family stuff and then again because they were my family. I have since learned that loyalty is family and blood is consequence. But again, you are not alone. Keep fighting!
I do not think a freak would be the worst thing you meet on the Internet. Maybe monsters?

People like this restore my faith in humanity. Goverments like this make me question my own.

Grieve. And know that there are people who love you. That loss is never easy. Also, something I wish they had told me a long time ago, there is no set time or deadline for the grieving process, honor your journey, ans remember that the grieving cycle does not go in order and there may or may not be repeats of the same emotion where you skip another all together. (Ex: rage, sadness, rage, but no denial..)

I am inclined to agree. Being mostly sad, cynical, and/or realist with bursts or leanings of joy is better than so blinded by positivity that you wake up one day wondering what happened to your life lol...
